composition: Maintain a strict 4:1 to 5:1 horizontal aspect ratio.
Use a 2-part layout: left-aligned logo mark (30% width) and right-aligned text (70% width), separated by a 1px vertical divider line.
For centered layouts, place a single symmetrical icon or 2-layer stacked text block exactly in the middle 40% of the canvas.
Backgrounds must feature dark, desaturated silhouettes (palm trees, city skylines, bridges) occupying the lower 50% of the frame.
typographie: Primary text must be bold, geometric, uppercase sans-serif with wide tracking.
Apply a 3D gel-like extrusion or a metallic silver-to-color gradient split horizontally at 50% height.
Secondary subtitles must be thin, elegant, and 50% smaller than the main title.
lumiere: Use a central radial spotlight or strong neon backlighting to isolate the main logo.
Apply a soft ambient glow (pink, red, green, or blue) emanating from the canvas edges or corners.
Incorporate subtle white rim lighting on the edges of 3D lettering to create depth.
etalonnage: Dominant background must be near-black or deep desaturated tones: #000000, #0B111E, #1A0508.
Accent colors must be high-saturation neon: Red (#FF0000), Green (#00FF33), Purple/Pink (#FF0055, #A832FC).
Text and foreground highlights must remain pure white (#FFFFFF) for maximum contrast.
effets: Apply a heavy dark vignette around the outer 15% of the canvas.
Overlay a subtle paper grain or photographic noise texture at 5% opacity.
Incorporate sparse dust particles, light leaks, or blurred white snowflakes/bokeh in the background layer.
logo: Integrate geometric monograms, anatomical elements, or celestial shapes framed by a thick neon border.
Ensure the logo has a strong outer glow matching the dominant accent color.
interdits: Do not use bright, fully-saturated background fills without a dark vignette.
Avoid complex, multi-colored vector illustrations without a unifying color wash.
Do not use default, un-styled sans-serif fonts without gradients, outlines, or custom cuts.
Avoid centering text blocks without an accompanying icon or structural framing.
personnages: Pose characters with a confident, relaxed, or intimidating attitude: hands holding cash, gesturing, or holding weapons in a low guard.
Dress characters in premium streetwear (hoodies, denim tube tops, knit vests, graphic tees) layered with heavy chrome/gold jewelry and designer sunglasses.
Render skin with a clean, semi-realistic 3D game engine finish, showing detailed tattoos and soft-painted textures.
Frame shots as vertical medium close-ups (waist-up) or dynamic full-body poses next to luxury assets like sports cars or music studio desks.
